Mfa No. 100682 of 2017
 Oral Judgment

This appeal is filed by the claimant seeking enhancement of the compensation awarded in the judgment dated 25.10.2016 by MVC No.2611/2015 by XI Addl. District and Sessions Judge and Addl. MACT, Belagavi.
2. The appellant/claimant was a pregnant lady sustained injury in a road traffic accident which occurred on 30.12.2010 and at that time, she was carrying seven months baby in the womb.
The said injuries caused in the accident affected health of the appellant/claimant and also of the foetus.
As a result, there was a death of foetus in the womb itself.
The foetus was subjected to post- mortem.
The appellant/claimant made a claim petition seeking compensation.
The Tribunal after recording the evidence, has awarded global compensation of Rs.50,000/- along with interest at the rate of 9% p.a.
The appellant/claimant is seeking enhancement of the compensation as awarded by the Tribunal.

Heard, learned counsel for the appellant and learned counsel for the respondent.
4.

The co-ordinate Bench of this Court in the case of The Divisional Controller, B.T.S Division,
Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation V/s Vidya Shindhe and Others has awarded compensation of Rs.1,50,000/- on account of death of two days baby.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the said case, as an impact of the accident, pregnant lady who has sustained grievous injuries and underwent surgery, gave birth to a male child which died after two days.

5. The co-ordinate Bench in the case of Bhawaribai and Another V/s New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
And Another1 decided on 04.08.2005 has awarded compensation for death of a foetus in the womb,
Rs.1,50,000/- for abortion, Rs.20,000/- towards Pain and agony, Rs.15,000/- towards medical expenses and Rs.6,000/- for loss of service of the pregnant lady to the 2006 ACJ 2085 NC:
2024:KHC-D:13131 family after abortion.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Delhi High Court in the case of Prakash and Others V/s Arun Kumar Saini and Another decided on 05.02.2010 has awarded compensation of Rs.2,50,000/-
for death of seven months old foetus.

entities.text: Prakash and Others V/s Arun Kumar Saini and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of National Insurance Company Ltd. V/s Kusuma and Another in Civil Appeal No.7212/2011 decided on 23.08.2011 has affirmed the award of compensation of Rs.1,80,000/- on account of death of a still born child.

entities.text: National Insurance Company Ltd. V/s Kusuma and Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: All the above cases are decided 10 years ago.

So, considering the passage of time, decrease in the value of money, the amount of compensation on account of death of a still born child should be in a sum Smt. Nirmal W/O. Gangappa Basapure vs Shri. Duradundi W/O. Girimallappa ...

2 of Rs.3,00,000/-.
6.
In view of the above, compensation as awarded by the Tribunal in a sum of Rs.50,000/- is enhanced to Rs.3,00,000/-.

7. In the result, the following:
NC: 2024:KHC-D:13131 ORDER i.
The appeal is allowed-in-part.
ii. The appellant/claimant is entitled to compensation of Rs.3,00,000/- with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realization.
iii. The respondent/owner of the vehicle has to pay the said compensation to the appellant/claimant.
